Wealth, grains (food etc.), family, death, enemies, metals, precious stones etc. are to be understood through the 2nd house.

chunk_text: From the 3rd house, know of the following : valour, servants (attendants etc.), brothers, sisters etc. initiatory instructions (upadesa), journey, and parent's death.

chunk_text: Conveyances, relatives, mother, happiness, treasure, lands and houses are to be consulted through the 4th house.

chunk_text: The learned should deduce from the 5th house amulets, sacred spells, learning, knowledge, sons, royalty (or authority), fall of position etc.
meta_groups: ['Career Dynamics', 'Children & Descendants', 'Dharma & Spiritual Path', 'Formal Education', 'Prominence & Governance']

chunk_text: Maternal uncle, doubts about death, enemies, ulcers, step mother etc. are to be estimated from the 6th house.
Wife, travel, trade, loss of sight, death etc. be known from the 7th house.
The 8th house indicates longevity, battle, enemies, forts, wealth of the dead and things that have happened and are to happen (in the past and future births).
Fortunes, wife's brother, religion, brother's wife, visits to shrines etc. be known from the 9th house.
meta_groups: ['Dharma & Spiritual Path', 'Past Life Patterns', 'Social & Family Relations', 'Travel & Journeys']

chunk_text: Royalty (authority), place, profession (livelihood), honour, father, living in foreign lands and debts are to be understood from the 10th house.
All articles, son's wife, income, prosperity, quadrupeds etc. are to be understood from the 11th house.
From the 12th house, one can know about expenses, history of enemies, one's own death etc.

Predict prosperity of the house which is conjunct or is aspected by a benefic. Also when its lord is in yuvavastha or in Prabuddhavastha or in Kaumaravastha or in the 10th house, the bhava's wellbeing is indicated.

The bhava which is not aspected by its lord or whose lord is with a malefic planet or with one of the lords of evil and such other houses (i.e. 3rd, 6th, 8th, 11th and 12th) or is defeated in a planetary war or is in one of the three Avasthas, viz, Vriddhavastha, Mritavastha and Suptavastha.
